## How Left Works

Are widgets free, or do I need to upgrade?

Left is free for most of the features and widgets. Only special dates and a custom lifespan are not free. Unlock everything with a one‑time, pay‑what‑you‑want purchase, choose from three prices and get the full app regardless of what you pay.How do I add a widget to my iPhone’s Home Screen?

- Touch and hold the Home Screen until apps jiggle.
- Tap**+**(top‑left) and search for**Left**.
- Pick a style and size (small, medium, large).
- Tap**Add Widget**, then long‑press the widget and choose**Edit Widget**to configure it.How do I add a widget to the Lock Screen?

- Touch and hold the Lock Screen and tap**Customize**.
- Tap the widget area and choose**Left**.
- Select the widget type you want and finish customization.

StandBy widgets can be added from the same customization flow.How can I change the widget size?

Size is chosen when adding a widget. In the system picker, swipe to select*Small*,*Medium*, or*Large*, then tap**Add Widget**. You can long‑press the widget later to edit its settings and style.How do I add widgets on iPad or Mac?

**iPad**: touch and hold the Home Screen → tap**+**→ search for**Left**→ choose size →**Add Widget**.

**Mac**: right‑click the desktop and choose**Edit Widgets**(or open Notification Center and click**Edit Widgets**) → search for**Left**→ drag a widget into place.Left doesn’t appear in my widget list

- Open the**Left**app at least once after installing.
- Update to the latest iOS/iPadOS/macOS and the latest app version.
- Restart your device and try adding the widget again.Why don’t widgets refresh more often?

iOS manages widget refreshes to save battery. Apps request updates, but the system decides when they occur. Opening Left updates widgets immediately; otherwise, refreshes happen on a schedule within the system’s budget.What devices are compatible?

Left is ready for**iOS 26**and works on all compatible iPhones. You can also add widgets on iPad and Mac.How many widget types are available?

Over 15 widget styles in multiple sizes, six color themes, and a range of symbols, each widget is fully customizable.How is life expectancy calculated?

Life expectancy is estimated using Apple Intelligence and multiple factors such as age, gender, activity, sleep, country of birth, and more.Does it work offline and is my data private?

Yes. Widgets work offline and data stays on your device. See our[Privacy](http://cristianrus.me/apps/left)page for details.What is a Year Progress widget?

A**Year Progress**widget shows how much of the current year has passed (or is left). It’s perfect for planning, reviews, and staying motivated across long‑term goals.Is Left a time left app?

Yes. Left is a**time left app**that visualizes the remaining time for days, weeks, months, years, and your lifetime, plus countdowns for events and habits.How do I add a countdown widget on iPhone?

- Touch and hold the Home Screen → tap**+**.
- Search for**Left**→ choose the**Countdown**style and size.
- Tap**Add Widget**→ long‑press the widget →**Edit Widget**to set your event and options.Is Left a Pretty Progress alternative?

Left offers similar functionality with a widget‑first approach, minimal design, and a one‑time pay‑what‑you‑want unlock. If you want**countdown**,**time left**, and**year progress**widgets with full customization, Left is a great alternative.Does Left have a habit tracker?

Yes. Left includes a**habit tracker**with daily, weekly, and custom schedules. Track habits with streak widgets on your Home Screen and see your progress at a glance.What is a days since counter?

A**days since counter**tracks how many days have passed since a specific date. Left's days since feature includes automatic streak tracking and a Home Screen widget to see your progress without opening the app.Can I track streaks with Left?

Yes. Left tracks**streaks**automatically — habits complete based on your schedule and reset only if you choose. Streak and habit widgets are available for your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy.
